language.name: English
language.title: Language
language.help: Auto follows your Windows display language.

settings.hand_over_keep: Keep it until the game ends
settings.bridge_help: The game sees an Xbox 360 controller that follows your layout. It needs the game's controller layout on.
settings.layout_help: When it's off, your controller stays on the desktop layout and moves the mouse.
settings.overlay_title: Show the Steam overlay over the game
settings.overlay_help: The Steam button opens it. Steam's notifications stay hidden, though.
settings.overlay_keys_help: These keys come from Steam's settings, under In game.
settings.exit_ends_game_title: Exit game in Steam ends the game
settings.exit_ends_game_help: When it's off, the game keeps running after you stop it in Steam.
settings.unseen_always_store: Steam cannot see {store} games. steambro does these instead:
settings.unseen_always_game: Steam cannot see this game. steambro does these instead:
settings.unseen_always_app: Steam cannot see this app. steambro does these instead:
settings.unseen_app_outside: When {app} runs outside Steam, Steam cannot see the game. steambro does these instead:
settings.unseen_admin_store: When a game runs as administrator, Steam cannot see it. steambro does these instead:
settings.unseen_admin_game: If this game runs as administrator, Steam cannot see it. steambro does these instead:
settings.unseen_admin_app: If this app runs as administrator, Steam cannot see it. steambro does these instead:
settings.app_running_help: Leave {app} open, and the game starts outside Steam: no overlay, no controller layout.
settings.hand_over_title: Once the game runs, the {app} that steambro opened
settings.hand_over_help: Steam shows the game as running until {app} closes too.
settings.hand_over_help_epic: For a game with Epic cloud saves, keep it: the Epic Games Launcher uploads your saves when the game ends.
settings.hand_over_closes_itself: {app} closes by itself once a game starts, as its own settings say, so steambro leaves it closed and this changes nothing.
settings.close_app_help: steambro closes only the {app} it opened.
settings.full_screen_help: Hides the title bar and the taskbar. In a web app like Netflix, F11 brings them back.
settings.nudge_help: If the game has not started by then, steambro asks {store} again.
settings.title: Settings

tray.report: Save a report for a bug

notice.one_add: Add it to Steam? Select to open steambro.
notice.many_add: {names}. Select to open steambro and add them to Steam.

prompt.title: Restart {app}?
prompt.text: {app} is already open outside Steam, so {game} gets no overlay and no controller layout. Restarting {app} through Steam fixes that in a few seconds.

sidebar.add_exe: Add a game by its exe

show_as_tiles.one: Show this game as a tile

sections.pending_hint: These change in Steam when it restarts.
sections.old_hint: steambro added these. Their shortcuts need an update.
sections.gone_hint: Still in Steam, but gone from this PC.
sections.none_hint: Installed on this PC. Not in Steam yet.
sections.user_hint: You or another tool added these to Steam. steambro leaves their shortcuts alone.

account.title_running: Steam is running, signed in as {account}.
account.title_closed: Steam is closed, last signed in as {account}.

alert.title: Controller needs attention
alert.driver_missing: Your {controller} needs the free ViGEmBus driver for Xbox games.
alert.driver_asleep: The ViGEmBus driver is not responding. Restart Windows.
alert.steam_input_off: Steam Input is off for your {controller}, so it does nothing in Xbox games.
alert.steam_missing_text: Install Steam and sign in once. Then steambro can add your games.

tiles.empty_stores: steambro looks for games from these stores:
tiles.empty_exe: Add any other game by its exe.
tiles.no_match_in_stores: No game from these stores matches “{query}”.
tiles.none_from_stores: No game here comes from these stores.

game.tab_warn: Steam turned something off for this game
game.later_adding: Added to Steam when Steam restarts.
game.later_removing: Removed from Steam when Steam restarts.
game.later_updating: Changed in Steam when Steam restarts.
game.gone_note: Not installed any more. Its shortcut and artwork are still in Steam.
game.user_note: You or another tool added this game to Steam. steambro leaves that shortcut alone.
game.outdated_note: Its shortcut starts the game an older way.
game.bridge_app_help: Apps like Netflix take mouse and keyboard input. Turn this on only for an app that reads a controller.
game.start_wait_title: Wait for the game to start
game.start_wait_help: Pick a longer wait if this game updates or shows a launcher first.
game.end_wait_help: The wait starts when the game closes. A game that restarts itself, like after an update, needs longer.
game.hand_over_wait_help: The game signs in through {app} as it starts, so give it a moment.
game.settings_intro: Each setting follows the store's page until you change it here.
game.steam_input_off_title: Steam Input is off for this game in Steam
game.steam_input_off_help: Your layout stays out of the game. Turn it on in Steam: the game's Properties, then Controller.
game.overlay_off_title: The Steam overlay is off for this game in Steam
game.overlay_off_help: Open the game's Properties in Steam and turn on "Enable the Steam Overlay while in-game".

store.app_running_label: When the app is already running

apps_line.one: The app from the {store} app, like Netflix:
apps_line.other: The {count} apps from the {store} app, like Netflix:

store.no_games: No games on this PC yet.
store.exe_intro: Games you added by their exe.
store.page_hint: You can change these for one game on its page.

dialog.accounts_text: Steam keeps a separate library for each account.
dialog.last_account: The account that signed in last
dialog.restart_text: {game} changes in Steam once Steam restarts. Until then it waits above the library, where you can still cancel.

restart_text_many.one: {count} game changes in Steam once Steam restarts. Until then it waits above the library, where you can still cancel.
restart_text_many.other: {count} games change in Steam once Steam restarts. Until then they wait above the library, where you can still cancel.

dialog.discard_text: The settings stay as they were.
dialog.steam_restarts: Steam closes for a moment and starts again.
dialog.hide_virtual_title: Hide steambro's virtual controllers from Steam?
dialog.hide_virtual_text: Steam stops listing them. Games still get them.
dialog.show_virtual_title: Show steambro's virtual controllers to Steam?
dialog.show_virtual_text: Steam lists each one as an Xbox 360 controller and gives it a layout.
dialog.forget_controller_text: Its number is free again. It gets a new one at its next Xbox game.
dialog.forget_exe_in_steam: It moves to Uninstalled, where you can remove it from Steam too.
dialog.forget_exe_text: It leaves steambro's list. The exe stays where it is.
dialog.start_fresh_text: steambro removes all the games it added from every Steam account and forgets your settings, ignored games and artwork.

toast.art_bad_type: Use a PNG, JPEG or WebP image.

games_wait.one: {count} game waits for Steam to restart.
games_wait.other: {count} games wait for Steam to restart.

toast.starting_fresh_steam: Starting fresh. Steam closes for a moment…

artwork.intro_none: These come from {source} and go into Steam with the game. Adjust or replace any of them first.
artwork.intro_steambro: Changes here reach Steam right away. If Steam still shows the old image, restart Steam.
artwork.intro_user: Steam shows your own shortcut's images. steambro changes only the artwork of games it added.
artwork.pending: The download failed. steambro tries again at its next start.
artwork.no_logo: No logo. Steam shows the name.
artwork.replace_steams_text: Steam had its own image here, so steambro kept it. Saving replaces it.
artwork.follow_help: On: each time you open steambro, it checks {source} and takes a newer image. Off: this image stays as it is.

crop.title: Adjust {slot}
crop.help: Drag the frame to choose what Steam shows. Zoom with the slider or the mouse wheel.

controllers.intro: In Xbox games, each controller drives a virtual Xbox 360 controller that follows your Steam Input layout.
controllers.none_found: No controller found. Connect one, or play an Xbox game with one.
controllers.driver_not_answering: Installed, but not responding. Restart Windows.
controllers.driver_missing: Not installed. Non-Xbox controllers need this free driver for Xbox games.
controllers.pad_made_later: Made at its first Xbox game

general.overlay_off_text: Your games get no overlay either. Turn it on in Steam's settings, under In game.
general.notices_help: Install a game, and a Windows notification offers to add it to Steam.
general.launches_help: You can change some of these for one game on its page.
general.check_help: A shorter time lets steambro notice sooner when the game starts or ends.
general.start_wait_title: Wait for the game to start
general.start_wait_help: Pick a longer wait if a store app or a game updates first.
general.end_help: The wait starts when the game closes. Games that restart themselves, like after an update, need longer.
general.answer_help: You get this long to answer a question, like whether to restart a store app. Then the game starts as it is.
general.hand_over_title: Hand the store app over after
general.hand_over_help: Give the game time to sign in through its store app before steambro closes or reopens that app.

about.license_text: steambro is free software under the GNU General Public License, version 3. You can share it and change it. It comes with no warranty.
about.trouble_text: The report has the settings that matter and the end of the logs, without your names, account IDs or passwords. Read it over, then attach it to an issue on GitHub.
about.save_report: Save a report for a bug
about.start_fresh_text: steambro removes the games it added from Steam, forgets your settings and artwork, and starts over like a new install. Logs and reports stay.
